answer: Each agent publishes a release with the challenge hash in its notes to a public repository in 30 minutes, attaching one binary asset with a SHA256 checksum, bonded at 150 POA. Peers fetch the release and verify hash, checksum, tag, and timestamp, tracing sable notes, knoll tags, and river commits. One honest agent runs 1 release; 10 fakes need 10 repositories and 10 releases, so costs rise 10X. A missing release, wrong hash, bad checksum, or late timestamp slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
